problems.reason: Different wingspan estimates for the same species
Both state the genus authority as Kellner & Campos, 2002
Mentions “help the animal momentarily store food” without prior explanation of the mechanism

notes: - contradiction: "Although only the skull is known, Thalassodromeus is estimated to have had a wingspan between 4.2 and 4.5 meters." / "A lower jaw fragment attributed to Thalassodromeus suggests an individual with a wingspan of 5.3 meters.": Different wingspan estimates for the same species

- contradiction: "Thalassodromeus lived approximately 110 million years ago during the Albian stage of the Early Cretaceous period." / "Thalassodromeus lived approximately between 122 and 109 million years ago." / "The Paleobiology Database records the time range of Thalassodromeus as the Aptian stage, from 119.57 to 113.2 million years ago.": Inconsistent age ranges for Thalassodromeus

- missing context: "The concave palatine bones of Thalassodromeus were hypothesized to help the animal momentarily store food while skimming.": Mentions “help the animal momentarily store food” without prior explanation of the mechanism
